resources.string: Your Home panel does more
MinkSpace Mini-Apps
Swipe vertically inside the Home panel to move between To-dos, Calculator, Media, and Music. Choose and arrange them in Settings; To-dos always remain available.
Your selected media, still yours
Add images, GIFs, or videos through Android’s picker. Mink stores a local reference and opens the original item in the app you choose.
Active media controls
With optional Notification access, Music can show Android’s active media session and send only the controls its provider supports. Mink does not record audio or keep listening history.
Faster switching · BETA
Try apps in Android bubbles
Long-press a Magic Box app result or choose automatic apps in Settings. Compatibility belongs to Android and the target app, so unsupported apps may open normally instead.
Each space has its place
A separate Work Apps drawer
Accessible work apps stay together with Android’s work badge and profile controls.
Privacy Space stays separate
Android Private Space apps never appear in regular search, shortcuts, or See All. Android or your device maker continues to own authentication and protection.
More keyboard-first refinements
Nextcloud Talk joins messaging integrations, first-match Enter actions are faster, and large-display layouts are more comfortable.
Open MinkSpace settings
To-dos always remain available. Enable and arrange Calculator, Media, and Music, then swipe vertically inside the Home panel to switch.
Work-profile apps live in a dedicated drawer. Android and your organization control whether that profile is available or paused.
Android Private Space and device-maker private areas stay outside regular search, shortcuts, and See All. Your device controls authentication.

MinkSpace order and enabled mini-apps are included. Calculator history, selected media and its Android grants, active media sessions, Work and Privacy Space state, device gateways, and active bubble notifications stay with this device.
